title: Earnings roundup: NVIDIA, Microsoft, Meta
description: Six figures from three earnings reports. Two of them are wrong.
text:
NVIDIA reported revenue of $96.2 billion for the second quarter of fiscal 2027, with diluted earnings per share of $2.46.

Microsoft's revenue for the quarter ended December 31, 2025 was $82.9 billion.

Meta Platforms reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $64.6 billion. Net income was $9.86 million, or $3.83 per diluted share.

title: NVIDIA Q1 FY2027 recap
description: A scale slip, a GAAP vs non-GAAP swap, and segment figures no filing breaks out.
text:
SANTA CLARA, Calif.—May 20, 2026―NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) today reported record revenue for the first quarter ended April 26, 2026, of $81.6 million, up 20% from the previous quarter and up 85% from a year ago.

For the quarter, GAAP earnings per diluted share were $2.39 and $1.87, respectively.

Data Center networking revenue was a record $14.8 billion, up 199% from a year ago and up 35% sequentially.
context: NVIDIA (NVDA), first quarter of fiscal 2027, the quarter ended April 26, 2026
